meta.name: api-design-principles
meta.description: Master REST and GraphQL API design principles to build intuitive, scalable, and maintainable APIs that delight developers. Use when designing new APIs, reviewing API specifications, or establishing API design standards.

copy.tagline: 设计直观可扩展的接口规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在设计或评审 API 接口,需要一套最佳实践。
copy.tagline_en: Design intuitive, scalable REST and GraphQL APIs using proven principles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing new APIs or setting API design standards.

howto.what: Claude 会依据 REST 与 GraphQL 的设计原则,帮你设计新接口、审查已有接口规范,并在命名、版本、分页、错误处理等方面给出具体建议。
howto.when: 当你要设计新的 REST 或 GraphQL 接口、审查接口规范,或为团队制定接口设计标准时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户订单的 REST 接口,给出资源和 HTTP 方法
say.note: 会按资源化命名和 HTTP 语义给出设计

say.text: 帮我审查这份 API 规范,指出命名和状态码的问题
say.note: 会逐条对照原文的最佳实践给意见

say.text: 我们的接口要做版本管理,推荐一种方案
say.note: 会对比 URL、Header、查询参数三种方式

howto.what_en: Claude applies REST and GraphQL design principles to help you design new APIs, review existing API specs, and suggest naming, versioning, pagination, and error-handling improvements.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you design new REST or GraphQL APIs, review API specifications, or set API design standards for a team.

say_en.text: Design a REST API for user orders, covering resources and HTTP methods
say_en.note: Applies resource naming and HTTP semantics

say_en.text: Review this API spec and point out naming and status code issues
say_en.note: Checks against the best practices in the skill

say_en.text: We need API versioning — recommend an approach
say_en.note: Compares URL, header, and query parameter versioning
